section_summary.extract_value: This section presents between-sex comparisons of body appreciation scores (BAS) from a study with 299 participants. One-way ANOVAs showed no significant sex differences in mean age or self-esteem, but significant sex differences were found in mean BMI. An ANCOVA with BMI covaried out revealed a significant effect of sex on BAS scores, indicating that men reported more positive body appreciation than women regardless of individual BMI differences.
